title: Chapter 211: The Choice Of The Naga Tribe
content:
Chapter 211: The Choice Of The Naga Tribe

"We will soon enter the main battlefield of the faction war through the relationship of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, and the development focus will shift!"

"If the nobles decide to give up the search for the illusory opportunity and want to withdraw from this area, we are willing to give enough compensation and accept the nobles' territory!"

Wu Qing retreated to advance. If the Naga tribe really didn't want to retreat, then let them stay here for the time being.

The existence of the Naga tribe has little impact on the Zerg. The Zerg can't use such a large area in this area now. Wu Qing mainly wants the population of the Naga territory.

The decision of the Naga tribe will ultimately depend on their persistence in the legendary opportunity, which Wu Qing cannot control.

"In fact, our tribe has long given up hope for the legendary opportunity!"

"The reason why we insist on staying here is that we don't want this place to fall into the hands of the evil god camp!"

"That opportunity is said to be a rumor, but it is actually true. Even if the possibility of obtaining the opportunity is very low, we can't let the evil god camp encounter the opportunity here!"

"Now that the evil god camp has retreated completely, our tribe no longer hopes for opportunities. Now evacuation is also one of the options!"

Naga looked at Wu Qing and expressed the idea that the Naga tribe could take the initiative to withdraw.

"Elder, you can raise any conditions, and I will try my best to meet them!"

Wu Qing responded.

Naga said that this is one of the options, and the meaning is already very clear. The Zerg wants to increase the attractiveness of this option.

Wu Qing asked Naga to raise her own conditions, and as long as they were not too excessive, he agreed.

"Although this small territory is insignificant to our tribe, it can help you overcome the initial difficulties and is of great value to you!"

"And handing this place over to you is equivalent to giving you the chance to get the opportunity. It is really unreasonable for us not to ask for some compensation!"

Naga thought for a while, looked at the Zerg army again, and said: "Then our tribe will ask the Zerg for a favor! And all the Zerg siege troops that came this time, how about it?"

The Naga tribe asked the Zerg for a favor, which is just a bond to maintain the relationship between the two tribes. The Naga tribe will not really ask the Zerg to repay the favor. If Wu Qing really wants to help the Naga tribe, it will be based on considerations of interests, not purely a personal relationship.

The alliance of interests is the most reliable. Wu Qing and Naga both understand this truth.

The Zerg troops that Naga wants are her real needs.

The Zerg siege troops she was referring to were the Zerg destroyers. The Zerg destroyers sent this time had a strength of over 10,000, including 5,000 one-star, 200 two-star, and 20 three-star. They were the core of the Zerg army's ultra-long-range firepower support.

It can be said that these Zerg destroyers were Wu Qing's accumulated assets for the Zerg, consuming a lot of resources and being the core embodiment of the Zerg's combat power.

The battle with the demons tomorrow will also be deployed with them as the center.

Naga's vision was very sharp, and she immediately picked the most valuable troops in this Zerg army.

"My tribe lacks this kind of long-distance siege-level troops. In most battlefields, we use the goblin creations to make up for it!"

"Although the goblin creations have good combat power, they are more limited and expensive, and they are inconvenient to use!"

"I have seen your siege troops in battle. Their body weaponization has evolved to the extreme, and they are powerful and have many advantages!"

"I will go to the front battlefield soon after I return to my tribe. I need such a force to assist my army in combat!"

"You can rest assured that I will ensure their safety, meet their needs, and pay you for your hire!"

Naga added, fearing that Wu Qing would disagree.

It is very common in this world to hire other tribes' troops to fight like Naga 妶. Many lords have such mercenaries under their command.

For Wu Qing, the Zerg army cannot be taken away by others. As long as there is a war to fight, it is actually the same wherever it is fought.

It is a very cost-effective exchange condition to exchange only a verbal favor and a Zerg destroyer army for the Naga territory in this area.

The reason why Wu Qing did not agree immediately was just a strategy. Negotiations between the two tribes cannot tolerate any carelessness.

Hearing Naga's words, it seemed that the Zerg had taken a huge advantage. In fact, Wu Qing could not tell what she was thinking.

If Wu Qing really used force and forcibly drove away the Naga tribe, the Naga tribe and the Tengu tribe would be helpless.

This was also forced by the situation. The Naga tribe had to leave. Naga should have discussed these things with Wu Qing so early in order to get as much benefit as possible.

When the two tribes defeated the demon tribe together and lost their common enemy, it was still unknown whether the two tribes could maintain such a friendly relationship.

Instead of doing so, it is better to give in in advance, leave a good impression on the Zerg, maintain the friendship established between the two tribes, and strive for greater benefits in the future.

Naga and Meng are of the same type. Her perception is very sharp. When she saw Wu Qing for the first time, even if it was just a Zerg clone, she could detect Wu Qing's uniqueness.

This is a feeling that cannot be expressed in words. Meng recognized Wu Qing and the Zerg because of this feeling. Naga is also in this situation now.

With the emergence of a person like Wu Qing, Naga has no doubts about the identity of the Zerg as a great clan.

The identity of a great clan is not conferred by oneself, but requires recognition from others.

Establishing a good relationship with a newly-entered clan like the Zerg in the early stages of development will bring benefits far beyond the current small profits.

"No problem!"

Wu Qing solemnly promised Naga.

"Then it's settled!"

"I still need No. 3 to help me command this Zerg army. I can't command a Zerg army!"

After receiving Wu Qing's promise, Naga was in a good mood and asked Wu Qing for Host No. 3.

Wu Qing also nodded in agreement.

Ordinary Zerg soldiers rarely communicate with others. Naga didn't know how to command this Zerg destroyer army. Host No. 3 has always been the commander of the Zerg reinforcements. Naga thought of Host No. 3, who had left a deep impression on her.

With the command of Host No. 3, she only needs to explain the combat intentions, and this Zerg army can exert their greatest combat power.

After an important matter was settled, Wu Qing and Naga were in a good mood.

Naga sent people to settle the Zerg army. She led important members of the Naga tribe to hold a simple welcome dinner for Wu Qing.

At the dinner, Wu Qing saw Gong Zhe and many representatives of various forces whom he did not know, as well as a representative of the Tengu tribe whom he had never seen before.

These people are all spectators for tomorrow's battle. The movement in the Naga territory is so big, and the intelligence capabilities of these forces are very strong, and many things cannot escape their eyes.

After obtaining Wu Qing's consent, Naga officially agreed to let all forces come to watch the battle.

Wu Qing certainly hopes that more people will come to watch, the Zerg tribe needs to become famous.

After the dinner, Wu Qing and Naga continued to communicate in depth about tomorrow's battle and the Naga tribe's voluntary withdrawal from this area.

After the business was over, the two chatted and asked each other about their respective concerns, which made Wu Qing have a better understanding of the outside world and Naga's understanding of the Zerg.

It was late at night, and Wu Qing said goodbye and left.

…

Before dawn the next day, the Naga army began to move.

The combat troops ate, put on equipment, and lined up, everything was in order.

Those responsible for logistics support did not rest all night and were busy all the time.

The soldiers of the Naga army, the squads gathered into large teams, the large teams gathered into square formations, and the army's square formations gathered more and more. Under the dim light of the early morning, it was dark and boundless, with no end in sight.

When the first ray of sunlight shone on the earth, the giant square formation of the Naga army set off to the designated battlefield.

The Zerg army was faster than the Naga army. The Zerg army did not need logistics supplies, did not need to wear equipment, and did not need to line up in advance.

As soon as the weirdness outside the territory retreated, the Zerg army rushed to the designated battlefield. Millions of Zerg puppies were divided into two parts, on both sides, guarding more than 300,000 Zerg main combat troops and marching quickly.

Arriving at the designated battlefield area, the Zerg army opened the battle formation and took the front position without hesitation, blocking the Naga army behind.

This was agreed upon by Wu Qing and Naga, and the Naga army also received the order to follow the Zerg army square formation honestly and serve as the battlefield background.

The demon army on the opposite side, like the Zerg, does not need logistical supplies, can easily go into battle, and the speed of deploying troops is not much slower than that of the Zerg.

Wu Qing can see from the vision provided by the Zerg host accompanying the army that the demon army has more than three million troops.

Among them, the proportion of dog demons and flame demons is very high. It can be clearly seen that there are thousands of three-star flame demons with ultra-long range distributed in various advantageous positions.

In the center of the demon army, a special flame demon rides a giant dog demon, surrounded by a group of powerful demons, and looks at the joint army of the Zerg and Naga tribes from a distance.

The Naga army has more than three million soldiers, which is equal to the demon army. Together with the more than one million soldiers of the Zerg army, the total force has exceeded the demon army by a lot.

In the Zerg territory, an air force consisting of 100,000 Zerg flying dragons and 20 Zerg queens, with three-star hosts and some Zerg explosive mosquitoes, has set off and is flying straight to the battlefield. It won't take much time for them to reach the battlefield.

Gong Zhe, the Tengu tribe and representatives of various forces all came to the high ground near the battlefield early, waiting for the start of the war.

The armies of both sides slowly spread out on this super huge battlefield. A war with a total force of more than seven million is about to begin!
